fees.notes: StudyMalaysia course page: international fees RM86,750. MSU official programme pages publish Malaysian fees only; no official international fee schedule available. Source: https://studymalaysia.com/what/course/MSU/0003081/ (accessed 2026-09-18).

requirements.general: You need at least a Full Pass in TWO (2) subjects or 2.00 CGPA at STPM/A-level; OR an MSU Foundation Certificate with minimum 2.00 CGPA; OR an MSU Diploma with minimum 2.00 CGPA; OR an equivalent qualification recognized by MSU Senate; AND a Pass in MUET.
